presets.name: Init
presets.description: A single Classic oscillator through the ladder: a blank sheet.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Event Horizon Sub
presets.description: A sine sub with a folded edge that only appears when you lean on the keys.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Redshift Reese
presets.description: Two detuned saws beating against each other, slowly sliding down the spectrum.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Magnetar Growl
presets.description: FM bass whose index opens with the mod envelope: a magnetic snarl.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ion Thruster
presets.description: Pulse bass with a tempo-locked pulse-width wobble that speeds up as Orbit comes up.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tidal Lock
presets.description: A rubbery square that pulls itself into pitch with a short glide on every note.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Perihelion
presets.description: A plucked Fraunhofer bass: bright attack, a dark spectral line sweeping through the decay.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Graviton
presets.description: Pure low weight: a triangle and a sine sub with a slow, heavy swell on the mod wheel.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Neutron Star
presets.description: Collapsed and dense: a folded wave through the comb filter tuned to the note.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Rogue Planet
presets.description: A wandering, unbound bass: Dark Matter spectra drifting under a resonant low-pass.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Coronal Loop
presets.description: Acid in infrared: the ladder at the edge of oscillation with an accented 16th lane.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Photon Lead
presets.description: A bright, singing saw stack; the mod wheel brings in vibrato.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Solar Flare
presets.description: Hard-sync scream: the Plasma table swept by an envelope, flaring on each note.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Cherenkov
presets.description: Blue glow in red light: an FM lead with a glassy upper partial that follows aftertouch.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Hawking Whistle
presets.description: A thin, pure whistle radiating from the edge: sine and noise breath through a band-pass.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Comet Tail
presets.description: A lead that leaves a trail: long ping-pong echoes that smear as Flux rises.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Lagrange Point
presets.description: Two oscillators balanced a fifth apart, held in place: a hollow, stable square lead.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ion Saw
presets.description: A thick supersaw for big melodies: seven voices wide, the sub tucked in underneath.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Doppler Glide
presets.description: Portamento lead whose pitch bends like a passing craft: long glide, pitch-bend to an octave.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pulsar Voice
presets.description: Pulsar synthesis as a lead: a formant that brightens as you play harder.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Infrared Dawn
presets.description: The signature: warm saws rising through the ladder, the sun coming up over the limb.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Heliopause
presets.description: The edge of the sun's wind: a thin, airy pad of filtered noise and a high, distant sine.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Oort Cloud
presets.description: A distant shell of icy bodies: glassy Quasar partials scattered by random note offsets.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Nebula Choir
presets.description: A vowel choir moving A through U, voices spread across the sky.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Cosmic Microwave
presets.description: The background hum of everything: warm, low, and faintly noisy.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Aurora Borealis
presets.description: Curtains of light: a slow sweep of the Fraunhofer lines with the chorus breathing.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Red Giant
presets.description: Swollen and warm, near the end of its life: a big pulse-width pad with a slow bloom.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Stellar Nursery
presets.description: Gas collapsing into new stars: Dark Matter frames morphing under a slow envelope.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Zodiacal Light
presets.description: Faint dust lit by the sun: a soft organ-like pad with a gentle shimmer on top.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Dark Side
presets.description: The far side, never lit: a low, filtered, slowly breathing pad for film cues.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Lightyears
presets.description: Distance as a sound: a slow-attack string pad that keeps going long after you let go.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ion Drive Organ
presets.description: Drawbars from flute to full registration on the Morph dial, with a spinning chorus.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Lunar Rhodes
presets.description: A tine piano from a moon base: FM bell-tone attack over a soft body, auto-pan on the wheel.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Starlight EP
presets.description: A bell-topped electric piano with a long, gentle decay and a little stereo shimmer.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Telemetry Keys
presets.description: Data streaming home: a clipped, slightly bit-crushed digital piano.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Clavis Orbita
presets.description: A funky clav in orbit: a narrow pulse through a velocity-bright band-pass.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Observatory Organ
presets.description: Full registration under a dome: big, reverberant, with slow Leslie motion.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Glass Console
presets.description: A crystalline keyboard: quantized phase on a sine gives a soft digital sparkle.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Mission Control
presets.description: Tight, punchy poly keys for chords: square and saw, short filter envelope.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pulsar Pluck
presets.description: Short pulsar bursts: a dry, rhythmic pluck that loves a dotted echo.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Quantum Pluck
presets.description: Superposed states: two detuned plucks that collapse into one as the note decays.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Kuiper Pluck
presets.description: Icy bodies at the edge: a glassy FM pluck with a bright, short ring, scattered in stereo.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Satellite Ping
presets.description: A beacon in low orbit: a sine ping with a short pitch drop and a long echo.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Micrometeorite
presets.description: Tiny, fast impacts: a noise transient exciting a short, metallic comb pluck.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Cassini Harp
presets.description: Rings of Saturn plucked like a harp: a soft triangle with a long, singing decay.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Spectral Pick
presets.description: A guitar-like pick with the Fraunhofer lines sliding; aftertouch bends the string.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Starfield Pluck
presets.description: Hundreds of points of light: a wide supersaw pluck for melodic house.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Quasar Bells
presets.description: A quasar's beacon: sparse bell partials, long and clear, panned by velocity.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Europa Ice
presets.description: Ice cracking over a hidden ocean: an FM bell with a cold metallic edge.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Titan Chimes
presets.description: Wind chimes on a hazy moon: random detuned bells with slow ring.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Bell Of Andromeda
presets.description: A grand, slow-struck bell with a hum tone underneath and a long bloom of reverb.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ringworld
presets.description: Ring modulation around a vast circle: clangorous and alien, tuned to a minor seventh.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Celestial Sphere
presets.description: Music of the spheres: soft sine bells a fifth apart, slowly turning in stereo.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Radio Beacon
presets.description: A distress beacon: square bell tone, bit-crushed and repeating into the void.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Dyson Bells
presets.description: A shell of mirrors around a star: bright bells smeared into a shimmering wall.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Supergiant Brass
presets.description: Big analog brass: saws with a swelling filter and a hint of growl.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Mothership
presets.description: Vast and descending: a detuned poly with a slow downward pitch at the start of each chord.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Saturn V
presets.description: Five engines lighting: a heavy, driven brass stab with the low end in front.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Corona Poly
presets.description: Classic poly synth chords with a halo: the Bend warp adds a bright corona.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Hyperdrive Stab
presets.description: Jumping to lightspeed: a short, bright chord stab with a pitch zip.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Starfleet Horns
presets.description: Heroic, warm horns: a soft-attack brass section for themes.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Orbital Stack
presets.description: A layered poly: saw, square and fifth stacked, with chord motion on Orbit.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Warp Core
presets.description: Reactor hum turned into chords: FM by oscillator B with a pulsing amp.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Orbit Arp
presets.description: The ORBIT mode: notes circling inward and back out, with the filter breathing per step.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Binary Stars
presets.description: Two stars in each other's pull: Pulsar mode pedals the root under every note.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Gravitational Waves
presets.description: Ripples in spacetime: an up/down arp whose rate and filter swell on a slow LFO.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Kepler Orbits
presets.description: Elliptical paths: triplet arp with accents falling on the planets' perihelia.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Astro Clock
presets.description: Precise, ticking, mechanical: a dry square arp with ratchets on the off-beats.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Satellite Swarm
presets.description: Many small craft crossing the sky: random order, random pan, sparse probability.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Pulsar Timing
presets.description: A millisecond pulsar: a rapid, pulsing chord arp locked to 1/32 with a gating rhythm.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ion Cascade
presets.description: Charged particles falling down the field: a descending arp with transposed echoes.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Galaxy Spin
presets.description: A spiral galaxy turning: Converge mode with a slowly opening, rotating stereo field.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Event Horizon Arp
presets.description: Falling in: a diverging arp whose folds harden as notes approach the edge.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Mission Sequence
presets.description: Hold one note: a full 16-step bassline plays itself, transposed by the lane.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Countdown
presets.description: T-minus: a descending sequence in eighth-note triplets that lands on the root.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Telemetry Bus
presets.description: Data on the line: a gated, bit-crushed digital sequence with probability dropouts.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Deep Space Network
presets.description: Dishes listening across the dark: a slow, wide, echoing chord sequence.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Launch Window
presets.description: Rising energy before ignition: an up-arp sequence that climbs octaves over a bar.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Morse From Mars
presets.description: A message in code: a sine beep sequence of dots and dashes.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Retrograde
presets.description: Apparent backwards motion: a Down/Up pattern with the swing pulled late.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Cosmic Ray Funk
presets.description: Funk from orbit: a bit-crushed clav sequence with ghost notes and pushes.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Dyson Sphere
presets.description: Energy harvested from an entire star: a dense, endless, slowly turning drone.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Interstellar Medium
presets.description: The thin gas between stars: filtered solar-wind noise with a faint harmonic glow.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Golden Record
presets.description: A greeting sent outward: a warm, organ-like drone with a slow vowel morph.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Singularity
presets.description: Everything pulled into one point: a low, folding drone that grinds as Heat rises.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Solar Wind Drone
presets.description: Particles streaming off the sun: a moving comb drone fed by wind noise.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Black Body
presets.description: Perfect thermal radiation: a pure, glowing, almost static sine cluster.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Cold Dark Matter
presets.description: Unseen mass holding everything together: sub-heavy, dark, shifting spectra.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Heat Death
presets.description: The last warmth of the universe fading: a slowly closing filter that never quite stops.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Radio Telescope
presets.description: Listening to the sky: crackling static and slow tuned whistles drifting by.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Magnetosphere
presets.description: The field that shields us: slowly ringing comb resonances in a shifting stereo field.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Crackle Of Jupiter
presets.description: Jupiter's radio storms: crackle noise through a sweeping formant filter.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Ion Storm
presets.description: Charged clouds: S&H-modulated noise bursts and pitch, stepping in time.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Spectrograph
presets.description: Splitting light into lines: the Fraunhofer table scanned end to end like a readout.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Sunspot Cycle
presets.description: Eleven years in a few bars: dark spots of filtering that come and go.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Sputnik
presets.description: The first signal from orbit: a lonely beep cycling through the static.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Planetarium
presets.description: Lights dimming, stars appearing one by one: a sparse, twinkling bed.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Re-Entry
presets.description: Burning through the atmosphere: a falling, distorted noise roar on each held note.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Liftoff
presets.description: Ignition and climb: noise and saw rising together over four seconds.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Supernova Riser
presets.description: A star collapsing then exploding: a swelling, chaotic riser that ends in a flash.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Wormhole Transit
presets.description: Folding space: a flanging, pitch-bending tunnel of comb-filtered noise.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Alien Signal
presets.description: Something answering back: a modulated FM chatter that never repeats the same way.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Laser Grid
presets.description: Targeting lasers: a fast falling zap on every note, sharp and dry.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Meteor Shower
presets.description: Streaks across the sky: random pitched noise bursts in a long stereo echo.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Gamma Burst
presets.description: The most violent flash in the universe: a short, extreme folded impact.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Tractor Beam
presets.description: Caught and pulled in: a wobbling, rising hum locked to the tempo.
presets.author: Chromosphere

presets.name: Docking Sequence
presets.description: Clamps engaging: a mechanical, ratcheting servo sound in rhythm.
presets.author: Chromosphere
